name: transporte-colombia
description: Monorepo Transporte Colombia (NestJS + React Native Expo)

scripts.start: npx concurrently -n "BACKEND,MOBILE" -c "yellow,cyan" "npm run start:dev --prefix backend" "npm run start --prefix mobile -- --go"
scripts.dev: npx concurrently -n "BACKEND,MOBILE" -c "yellow,cyan" "npm run start:dev --prefix backend" "npm run start --prefix mobile -- --go"
scripts.tunnel: npx concurrently -n "BACKEND,MOBILE" -c "yellow,cyan" "npm run start:dev --prefix backend" "npm run start --prefix mobile -- --go --tunnel"
scripts.lint: npm run lint --prefix backend && npm run lint --prefix mobile
